title: From the homepage to a Charleston show, saved and shared
description: Instructional walkthrough on a phone, under one minute: start on the extrachill.com homepage, open the events calendar, search Charleston, narrow to This Weekend, open Channel Bluff at Charleston Pour House, tap Going, point at Get Tickets, and share it. Seeds a Charleston weekend at real public venues dated to the current or coming weekend. Doubles as the regression for that path; demo mode renders it as a captioned MP4 (extrachill-network#328).
